title: Placement Term Length and the Initial Service Documentation — Hardship and Protective Holds
content:
**Band table.** Under Hardship and Protective Holds, the term cut of the initial service documentation on a Military Service Hold request depends on the placement term length of the requested account's stage — the length of the placement term at that stage under Placed Consumer Accounts, in calendar days. The cut is subtracted once from the days allowed for the initial service documentation.

| Placement term length of the account's stage | Term cut |
|---|---|
| No more than the short-term days, 150 | 5 calendar days (short-term cut) |
| Above 150 but no more than the standard-term days, 365 | 2 calendar days (standard-term cut) |
| Longer than 365 days | Nothing |

**Both sides.** A term of 150 days: cut 5. 151 days: cut 2. 365 days: cut 2. 366 days or more: nothing.

**Example (hypothetical).** The requested account sits at a stage whose placement term is 455 days: longer than 365, so nothing is cut.
